clause: LAW-12 genesis clause, watch/inbox/BURN_rsi-harness_20260926.md falsifier: one scenario card per G1-G7 minted from real REGISTRY.jsonl FAIL rows within 14 days of registration
citation_provenance: Retro-cited 2026-09-26 by the B2-162 tripwire (watch/inbox/burn_wave_20260926/B2_162_g1_tripwire_20260926.md): line 20 is the first genuine fleet G1 FAIL row in REGISTRY.jsonl, a real gate FAIL verdict on tools/probe20_run.py (fleet tool from the gala-night battery), cited by its ts+digest identity; the line field records the citation-time position only, and the registry is append-only so cited line numbers are stable under it. History kept, never erased: at clause time no G1 FAIL row existed in REGISTRY.jsonl (rows 1 through 17 all show G1 ok=true, every fleet submission already carried a fan-out), so line 18 (ts 2026-09-26T11:57:07Z, name scenario-g1-fixture, digest 4be79ce0f674) was minted 2026-09-26 by running the real gate (tools/workflow_gate.py check --script, exit 2) on this card's own fixture. The fixture is a labeled regression input, not a fleet submission; that row is real gate output, disclosed rather than synthesized, and it stands as history and regression anchor beside the fleet citation.
scenario_description: Fan-out loop dispatches every item to one shared unnamed actor (agent(worker, ...)): no per-item named actor, so a dead run takes every item down together and per-item salvage attribution is impossible.
regression_criterion: tools/workflow_gate.py check --scenarios configs/workflow_gate_scenarios exits 0 with this card green. The card goes red if (a) the gate stops flagging fail_g1.dwf.ts (G1 regex weakened or removed), (b) the fixture starts failing gates beyond expected_verdict.failed_checks (false positive creep), or (c) the cited row disappears from REGISTRY.jsonl. Card and fixture are immutable inputs: a G1 semantics change requires a new dated card filed alongside, never a silent edit.
rollback_note: Scenario mode is read-only: it writes no registry row and touches no file. Rollback of a G1 gate change is a git revert of tools/workflow_gate.py to the pre-change blob, then re-run check --scenarios expecting green. The minted registry row (line 18) is history and is never erased; the fixture stays so the reverted gate can be re-proven.
